atomic_accuracy_verdict.reason: The released atomistic output ends at 1000 eV, below 94.898% of this IEAD. The direct species-resolved SiO2 beam board ends at 2000 eV, below 86.817% of this IEAD. A depth calculation can therefore be a declared high-energy/species sensitivity, but not an atomic-level prediction, until a validated high-energy reactive-event closure and species-resolved reactor boundary exist.
